name: Tsudanuma Mei
source:
A first year at Seiran High School and a disciplinarian commitee member. Despite only being a freshman, she's an skilled hacker that plays a big part in the commitee. Her personality is serious and docile, but sometimes she becomes a maniac.

[from [url=http://quinrose.com/game/sw/character.html]Official site[/url]]
